This can stack. }} ==Description== The '''Shivergeist''', internally referred to as '''Frost Wraith''', is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy that appears in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. It is a slightly fast enemy with a decent amount of health. Due to it being a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, only towers with hidden detection can target it. It is also a [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] enemy, which means units cannot collide with it. Moreover, anything that deals unit collision damage also cannot deal damage to it. Upon death, the '''Shivergeist''' will apply a 33% speed boost to any enemy in its range of 15 for 5 seconds. These boosts can stack. ==Appearance== The '''Shivergeist''' is a floating creature with no legs, instead having aquamarine chunks of ice below its torso instead. It has an entirely translucent body. Its arms are not connected to its body, nor is its head. It has icy teardrop-shaped spikes coming out of either side of its head, with more minor spikes appearing as well. It has glowing white eyes and no mouth. Its arms are covered in ice and the ice forms into claws to make for its hands. Its torso crumbles apart toward the bottom. ==Strategy== *Since this enemy appears somewhat later into the match, hidden detection should be available. **Late game tower with it like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Juggernaut]], [[Engineer]] or [[Enforcer]]. **As it has [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]], summoner towers like the [[Necromancer]] or [[Military Base]] will be far less effective. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFrostWraith.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (3 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Pulse Trooper Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Shivergeist''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Shivergeist''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The name '''Shivergeist''' comes from a combination of two words: ''shiver'' from English and ''geist'' from German, which roughly translates to Ghost, Spirit and Mind. *The '''Shivergeist''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''3 December 2025''' -
